why: During-filmstrip from k=2 confirms the big turnaround paid off: mid-turn frames pass a corner/bench/door, then the last two frames reveal a second gate coming into view -- two yellow posts with cyan tassels. The left post sits left-of-center and the right post is near the right edge, so the gap center is slightly right of image center; the proposed move (forward ~1.1m, right ~1.0m in body frame, small descent, negligible yaw) matches that -- it angles toward the gap rather than away from it. Trust is low (0.47) which I'm noting to watch closely, but I don't see a specific problem in the current view to override on, so approving and will judge the transit from the next filmstrip.
